items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: them guys get up on those old big foots, get up there and call figures. Ladies fast. Bob Foots.

ctx.x: 12 o'clock playing quadrilles. 12 o'clock, first figure, yeah. 11.30, 11.30, first figure. Yeah, first figure, yeah. 11.30, first figure, first figure, And they all rest there.

See, now you wait till they all light up on the floor. All right, them guys get up on those old big foots, get up there and call figures. Ladies fast. Bob Foots. Yeah, just to the right, promenaded, man. Cut the wing and you...
Well, the same people that liked the blues liked the quadrilles.
